title: Blood Magic
text:
Blood Magic is a keystone passive skill that remove all of your Mana and changes Mana Cost to Life Cost.


== Mechanics ==


== Location ==
Blood Magic is located on the left side of the passive skill tree.


== Related unique items ==
These unique items have the Blood Magic modifier, which grants the effects of this keystone. These effects do not double up by also having the keystone allocated.
